title: GTIN present
question: Do sampled products carry a GTIN?
method: Read gtin, gtin8, gtin12, gtin13 or gtin14 from the Product JSON-LD or its hasVariant Products, or global_unique_id from the Store API. A value counts only when it is 8, 12, 13 or 14 digits after spaces and hyphens are removed. Pass when at least 80 percent of sampled products have one. Warn above 50 percent, or at or below it when every product without a GTIN carries brand and mpn, Google's documented alternative. Fail when products without a GTIN also lack brand plus mpn.

title: GTIN valid
question: Are the GTINs real GTINs?
method: Check every GTIN B3.1 counted, on the product and its variants: 8, 12, 13 or 14 digits after spaces and hyphens are removed, and a correct GS1 check digit. Pass when all are valid, fail when any is not. Skipped when no sampled product carries a GTIN. Values of the wrong length are not GTINs here and appear as invalid format in B3.1.

title: Brand present as entity
question: Is the brand a Brand object with a consistent name?
method: Read Product.brand on each sampled page with Product JSON-LD. Pass when every product names its brand, as a Brand (or Organization) object with a name or as a bare string (noted: Google recommends brand.name on a Brand object), with consistent casing across the sample. Warn when a brand object lacks a name or has another or no type, or when the casing of a brand name varies. Fail when any product has no brand.

title: MPN present when GTIN absent
question: Do products without a GTIN have a brand plus MPN fallback?
method: For sampled products without a GTIN, read mpn (on the Product or its variants) and the brand name (a Brand object's name or a bare string). Pass when every one carries both. Warn when some carry only one of the two. Fail when any carries neither. Skipped when every sampled product has a GTIN.

title: SKU present and unique in sample
question: Does every sampled product have a SKU, and are they distinct?
method: Read sku (or productID, which Meta's on-page markup uses) from the Product JSON-LD or its variants, else sku from the Store API, and record the field that supplied it. Pass when every sampled product has one and no two share it. Warn when two sampled products share one. Fail when any has none.
